status: proposed; not run; refines PRB-S4-05 after the N7 native trace
target: Ableton Live 12 Suite 12.4.3 (2026-07-07_e3d8be4d07), macOS host only
common_prerequisites: Reuse the PRB-S4 common prerequisites (pinned executable, verified virtual MIDI port, fresh preferences, retained Log.txt)
Read parameter values through a read-only observer whose own latency is characterised first; never use an arbitrary sleep as evidence of no change
Record the Takeover Mode preference before each probe and set it explicitly; its default is unknown
Open the MIDI input (Remote on) before the first message and send nothing else on the probed channel/controller, so the prior-value table starts at its -129 fill

probes.question: Do Absolute and Absolute14Bit produce min + (max-min) * v/127 and v14/16383 on a continuous parameter, and is the 14-bit value applied only when both halves have arrived?
probes.existing_evidence: 0x101b76bf0 absolute branch; pairing 0x101b8028c/0x101b802bc/0x101b7fcc0 (kept results n7-0002); cases MT-01 to MT-05
probes.why_static_insufficient: Static trace ends at the parameter setter 0x101b0d328; display rounding, smoothing and deferred application (OChangeControllerDataCommand) are unmeasured
probes.minimal_input: EncoderMapMode Absolute then Absolute14Bit, Encoder1: 20, a device with a continuous parameter in slot 1; send the MT-01 to MT-05 byte sequences
probes.discriminating_observation: Parameter value after each message; in particular no change after a lone MSB
probes.stopping_condition: All MT-01 to MT-05 readings taken once; stop

probes.question: Do the eight relative modes produce the per-message deltas of MT-06 to MT-14, including the table fallbacks (AccelSignedBit 10..64 -> 20, AccelBinaryOffset 64 -> +50, AccelTwoCompliment 0 -> +50)?
probes.why_static_insufficient: Numerical fidelity at the parameter requires measurement under ADR 0002
probes.minimal_input: One continuous parameter with min 0 and max 1 at 0.5; each mode in turn; MT-06 to MT-14 sequences
probes.discriminating_observation: Value after each message, tolerance 1e-6 on the LOM value
probes.stopping_condition: One pass per mode; stop at the first mismatch and record it

probes.question: With Takeover Mode Pick-Up and Value Scaling, do MT-19 to MT-23 hold, including the unchanged value on the first message after the input opens?
probes.why_static_insufficient: The preference default, the reset trigger of the prior table (0x101b68f98) and status-bar side effects are untraced
probes.minimal_input: Volume slider and crossfader assignments; MT-19 to MT-23 sequences; reopen the input between cases
probes.discriminating_observation: Value after each message; whether an unrelated earlier CC on the same input changes the prior

probes.question: Do quantized and on/off parameters follow MT-15 to MT-18 (round half away from zero; one step per relative message; on inside MidiCCOnOffThresholds)?
probes.existing_evidence: 0x101b76bf0 frinta, 0x101b7f894 accumulator, 0x101b7fde4 Type 2 branch, 0x1026fa684 threshold range; shipped sets carry Min 64 Max 127 in 22,059 of 22,303 occurrences
probes.why_static_insufficient: The registry lookup 0x1011aeb80 that can disable the threshold range is unexplained; per-parameter class membership (ATimeableBool/Enum/Float) is not listed
probes.minimal_input: A device with an on/off and a quantized parameter in the first two encoder slots; MT-15 to MT-18 sequences

probes.question: Ordering and coalescing: is every message applied in arrival order when sent back to back (including MSB, unrelated CC, LSB interleaving), or can deferred application drop or merge messages?
probes.existing_evidence: 0x101b7fde4 posts OChangeControllerDataCommand when not on the expected thread; dispatch 0x101b7842c calls every handler on a channel/controller
probes.why_static_insufficient: Thread and queue behaviour are runtime properties
probes.minimal_input: Absolute14Bit and LinearSignedBit mappings; bursts of 100 messages at the port's maximum rate
probes.discriminating_observation: Final value equals the derived sum or last pair; any intermediate drop
